description: This file defines an interface named 'Job' representing a scheduled job within a job management system. It includes methods for querying job state, identifiers, timing, priority, and managing job state transitions.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: An interface representing a scheduled job with methods to manage and query its lifecycle and properties.

inner_enums.name: State
inner_enums.description: Enumerates the possible states of a job: CREATED, QUEUED, RUNNING, FINISHED, FAILED.

methods.name: currentState
methods.description: Returns the current state of this job.

methods.name: getJobId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this Job.

methods.name: getJobName
methods.description: Returns the name of this Job.

methods.name: getRuntime
methods.description: Returns the job execution time in milliseconds; zero if not yet run.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Returns true if this job is ready to be queued.

methods.name: deQueue
methods.description: Transitions this job to the created state, called when problems occur adding the job to the queue.

methods.name: queue
methods.description: Transitions this job to the queued state.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the scheduled start time of the job.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority of this job; higher number indicates higher priority.
